name: Strategy005 volume-spike dip buy (Fisher RSI + fast stoch)
author: Gerald Lonlas (freqtrade-strategies)
indicators: RSI(14), Fisher RSI norm=50*(fisher+1), STOCHF, MACD, MINUS_DI, SAR, SMA40, volume SMA
entry_long: volume > rolling_mean(volumeAVG)*4 AND close<SMA40 AND fastd>fastk AND RSI>buy_rsi AND fastd>buy_fastd AND fisher_rsi_norma<buy_fishRsiNorma (hyperopt params; close>2e-6 floor)
exit: (any of the enabled) RSI crosses above sell_rsi, MACD<0, MINUS_DI>sell_minusDI, SAR>close; combined with AND in source loop (read source)
implementation_notes: Default hyperopt parameter values not captured in my extraction (buy_rsi, buy_fastd, buy_fishRsiNorma, sell_*); read class attributes. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
